questions: What is a notice?
If the notice never arrives, does the deadline still start?
What is detention?
When detention ends, is the person free to leave?
What does consent mean?
If consent is withdrawn, does everything already done disappear?
What is a sanction?
If a sanction is lifted, does that mean the conduct is now allowed?
What is a benefit?
If a benefit is suspended, does the money stop immediately?
What is an emergency?
When an emergency ends, does everything return to normal immediately?
What is removal?
If removal happens, does it erase everything that came before?
What is registration?
If registration is cancelled, does everything connected with it disappear?
What is a seat?
If a seat is empty, can anyone take it?
What is access?
If access is blocked, does the requester lose the right to know?
What is a review?
If the review is unfavorable, does the decision have to change?
What is a petition?
If a petition gets enough support, must the decision change?
What is a veto?
If a veto is used, is the proposal gone for good?
What is discretion?
If discretion is used, can the outcome still be challenged?
What is a license?
If a license is renewed, does the old one simply keep running?
